bugs_found: apply_fee: uses 'assert False, "fee_pct negative"' for input validation — assertions are stripped when Python runs with -O/-OO, so negative fee_pct will silently pass validation in optimized builds, allowing nonsensical/negative fees
apply_fee: inconsistent error type — other validations raise ValueError, but this one raises AssertionError, breaking caller exception-handling contracts
apply_fee: assertions for input validation is a documented anti-pattern (CWE-617) and should be replaced with an explicit raise ValueError
